scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @bga/api run db:prepare && concurrently -k --names pkgs,api,web --prefix-colors gray,blue,magenta "pnpm run watch:packages" "pnpm --filter @bga/api run dev" "pnpm --filter @bga/web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm run test:process && pnpm -r run test
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:bundle && pnpm e2e
